summary: Plan for #55 meets the spec and stays fail-closed: a trusted setup_trust module records the baseline through one launcher writer only for exactly-installed inputs with reviewed configuration; ADR-0014 and the BL-INV-002 amendment carried; agent-provisional.
basis: plan.md traces every FR-001..FR-020 to research R1-R19 and every AC-001..AC-027 to a test or review step in quickstart.md. The data-model eligibility order puts all local refusals before the single network step, so an ineligible checkout makes no request (FR-004, AC-014..AC-016). The launcher stays the single owner of trusted.json and the reviewed-repositories record through record_baseline; the comparison, refusal messages and BALLAST_TAMPERED are unchanged (FR-015, AC-023). The default branch is observed live through ADR-0005's hardened throwaway path, never from agent-writable refs, matching the D-02 refinement in the agent-provisional intent PD-0005. The Constitution Check passes with one justified amendment: BL-INV-002 is amended through governance as the operator chose in D-01 (recorded in discovery.md, commit f290079), with ADR-0014 superseding the ADR-0007 and ADR-0011 clauses; both stay proposed until merge. The independent plan review (PD-0006, reviews/plan.md) verified code claims against the tree and found no fail-open path. Its two medium items (supersede ADR-0011's network wording in ADR-0014; share the branch-sync Git environment builder) and three low items are fixable while writing the ADR, module and tasks, and are carried to tasks and to security and architecture review. Material: it amends a constitutional invariant and accepted ADRs. Risk stays R2 per docs/policies/project/workflow.md. Before merge, the quickstart's networked end-to-end check needs ballast trust and the scratch GitHub repository; the operator listed exactly these two actions in ballast.toml [autonomous] on 2026-10-06 (#92).
